name: Muddled Escape (1/Day)
description: If an attack would reduce the creature’s hit points to 0, it collapses into a pool of filth-laden swamp water and its hit points are reduced to 1 instead. The creature can move at its normal speed in this form, including moving through spaces occupied by other creatures. As a bonus action at the beginning of the creature’s next turn, it can reform, still with 1 hit point.
